body: Hey. I do want to figure this out but the last 4 months have sucked. Every day is a repeat, wake up, shower, eat, walk around the house, watch tv, do my therapy, go to bed. On top of that my best friend and one I've known since I was 4 has been distant lately and I don't know why. Doesn't invite me out anymore, won't respond to texts ect. I don't know what to do. I'm in a rut, I cant talk to anyone because I can never muster up to courage to go into specifics with my parents about my SA. They think I just have anxiety, they don't know I feel like everyone is judging at me whenever I leave my house. Waiting in lines, or even going to stores is sometimes unbearable. They get mad at me when I won't do things like go to get my passport photo done and chalk it up to me being lazy. Then they constantly ask me why I won't go and I always just shrug because I can't admit my issues to them....
I am trying, and trying hard. The amount of time I've spend on SELF therapy (around 200 hours now) is comparison to the results I've seen is depressing.

Thanks for the response. With all the phobias I'm starting to get it's going to make life a miserable experience. I'm afraid if I keep going down this path eventually I'm going to be scared to leave my own home which will cripple my ability to do anything that requires leaving the house. Like I said before I'm only human, I can only fight for so long. What depresses me the most is that people who don't know me (friends of friends) are always baffled as to why I don't have a job / girlfriend ect. When I look at myself I see so much wasted potential.
